data.title: Keturah Reserve
data.about:
Keturah Reserve by MAG Group is the epicenter of innovation and allure, where you can live in harmony with nature. It is part of the gated community of Meydan, one of Dubai's most popular neighborhoods located in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. 

Keturah Reserve is a luxury development that redefines contemporary architectural and interior concepts. Drawing inspiration from Bio-Living principles, the property aims to establish a connection between residents and their natural surroundings.

The development includes superhome apartments in 2, 3, and 4-bedroom configurations.  Residents can immerse themselves in activities that enhance wellness across every facet of their lives. Keturah Reserve Meydan will offer a lifestyle perfect for residents of all ages and interests, providing engaging activities for everyone. MAG Group is known for coming up with phenomenal projects, including Keturah Tower in Business Bay.

characteristics_module.title: Boasting Bio Living Architecture and Environment-friendly Amenities
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Showcasing Biophilic designs inspired by the Bio Living concept
  • Naturally self-sustaining homes provide residents with plenty of sunlight and a subtle and healing ambience
  • Inclusive services include paint retouching, maintenance, valet parking, moving-in assistance, and more
  • Flexible and attractive payment plan with booking starting from just 20%
  • Featuring 2 to 4-BHK spacious and sustainable super homes
  • A pet-friendly development offering facilities like spa and grooming, as well as dog walking
  • Exquisitely designed townhouses with hairline finishes and frameless doors and windows
  • Exceptional amenities inside the units: vanity counters, spacious balconies, and a study area.

location_tile.title: A Collection of Superhomes in MBR City
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Started as an idea of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the Ruler of Dubai, Meydan has become a home to luxury properties and a hub of leisure activities. Keturah Reserve Dubai will be another addition to the glorious community near Downtown Dubai. From the Meydan Racecourse to exclusive residential enclaves, Meydan MBR City is a testament to Dubai's commitment to creating a modern, sustainable, and globally recognized cityscape that harmoniously integrates with the natural surroundings.

  • 07 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 12 mins – DIFC
  • 15 mins – Business Bay
  • 21 mins – Dubai International Airport
